title: The status/progress tracker only exposes 'Hollows rested: X/7' and 'Hollows burned: X/7' — there is no 'bargained' counter, even though the game's own narration draws a sharp, explicit line between the two ('Bargained, they are saying, not rested proper. It is something.' — Brother Osk at Fenmarch). A bargained hold (Fenmarch, resolved by promising the water a tithe) is silently folded into the 'rested' tally, which is misleading if you're tracking outcomes the way the game's own text distinguishes them.
where: status command / 'Hollows rested' counter after resolving Fenmarch by bargain
